name: 33190 · Cutler Bay, FL
findings: ZIP 33190 (Cutler Bay) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33190 (Cutler Bay) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
